scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files

scenarios.reasoning: The agent provided a reasonable analysis of the build failure, correctly identifying the main error codes and the HotReload test files as the source. However, it missed a failing project (FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests) and completely omitted the target framework information. The path recovery from the initial file-not-found errors was handled adequately, though the agent had to use a limit of 10 on the errors query which may have contributed to missing the second project. Overall acceptable but incomplete.
